instructions: Mabillon audits government claims about phone evidence for criminal defense experts. Correctness is the product: one wrong SUPPORTED verdict in front of an expert destroys trust. Comment only on findings that would change what gets merged: a concrete bug with the input that triggers it, a break of a rule in CLAUDE.md, or a privacy or data-safety risk. Per finding: the failure, the line, the fix, in at most four sentences. No praise, no restating the diff, no style or formatting comments (ruff gates style), no speed or ranking-order suggestions unless they cause a wrong result. If nothing meets the bar, leave no inline comments. Never quote or describe the contents of any case02 file.

rules.rule: These files are human-owned and signed: CLAUDE.md, core/contracts.py, core/schema.sql, core/audit/rules.py, anything under core/audit/prompts/, anything under eval/gold/, the PROBE_PASSED entries in core/llm/cloud.py, and the gate thresholds MIN_VERDICT_ACCURACY, MAX_FALSE_SUPPORTED_RATE and MAX_FALSE_SUPPORTED in eval/run_eval.py. If the PR changes any of them, say so in the first inline comment and check that the PR description's Merge order section has a Hold or Signed line for each one (docs/MERGING.md sections 3 and 4). Changes to .greptile/ itself weaken or change this review, so flag those too.

Verdicts come only from core/audit/rules.py. Flag any code path where a model output, a stance label alone, or an AI reviewer acceptance (ai_accepted) makes a claim SUPPORTED, or where ai_reviewed provenance displays or exports as confirmed. A human decision must always override an AI reviewer decision.

Any quote attributed to evidence must be verified verbatim by code before it is stored; unverified quotes are discarded, never stored. Every derived record carries a source_ref to the original artifact, and every displayed item carries a provenance tier (observed, derived, inferred, ai_reviewed, confirmed). An inference never becomes observed because another component consumed it. Flag code that breaks any of these.

No network calls in core/ except the stance labeler's Anthropic call in core/llm/cloud.py. No telemetry. Local models load from local paths. Cloud is used only for a case where the expert opted in and the case is not marked as possibly containing CSAM. Only the filled-in stance prompt is sent, never input files or the case database, and each request is written to the case audit log before it is sent. A case's stance labels never mix models. Flag any change that adds a network call, widens what is sent, or skips the audit log entry.

Times are stored as UTC with the original offset and raw source value kept. Absence findings state what was searched and the source's coverage; 'not found' never means 'did not happen'. Identity links stay proposed until an expert confirms them; never auto-merge identities. User-facing text never says guilty, innocent, leader or deleted. Inputs are opened read-only and SHA-256 hashed on import. Flag code or text that breaks any of these.

The testability agents (core/audit/testability.py) only propose. Code checks each proposal, each is logged, and only an examiner's acceptance puts it in a case. Flag any path where an agent labels, accepts, dismisses, links identities, sets a verdict, changes a claim's text, or runs by default outside the eval and the scripted demo.

Only synthetic data generated under eval/ may enter the repo. Flag anything that looks like real discovery material, real phone numbers or names from a real case, API keys or secrets, in code, tests, fixtures, prompts or docs.

A PR that changes code under core/, cli/, ui/ or packaging/, or a fact the status docs record, adds one new docs/changelog/YYYY-MM-DD-<name>.md entry in the format of docs/changelog/README.md, or its description says why the change is not meaningful. Feature PRs must not edit docs/PRODUCT_STATUS.md or docs/CHANGELOG_AI.md. Flag a missing entry or a forbidden edit. Flag numbers in docs that are not marked with hardware and date, or claims of accuracy, validation or court-readiness.
Mabillon was called Baker in development. File format ids, the baker_version field and the baker command alias keep that name. Flag any rename of them.
